heading: multiview ML-1 — `paper-height`: a tie at the tolerance
text: Defect of the matrix, repaired (decision D50 in `K/🗂️work-board.md`). Every dimension and extent comparison against D18 is now decided in whole micrometres (`micrometres`, `withinD18` in `T/🧰️.ts`, used by `geometryFindings` and `paperFindings`): a difference that equals the tolerance is within it in metres and on the paper of every scale, one micrometre more is a finding everywhere; the tolerance itself is unchanged. Measured on the catalog document with `🧰️matrix/MX/probe-shared.ts`: old rule at 1:50 `0.46000000000000085 > 0.45999999999999996` and at 1:100 `0.23000000000000043 > 0.22999999999999998` (finding); now drawn 1,127,000, nominal 1,150,000, tolerance 23,000 micrometres at both scales, no `paper-height`, no `dimension-*`. Test first: vector `paper.tie` and the case "decides a difference that equals the D18 tolerance in whole micrometres" (synthetic figure at 1:20, 1:50, 1:75, 1:100, 1:150, the harmonium at 1:50 and 1:100, Python's exact rational arithmetic as the oracle); suite `🔭️multiview-coverage` 41 of 41. `used-harmonium` needs no asset change: re-measure with `T/🔎️scan.ts --language en used-harmonium` and the matrix of the asset (its record is older than the engine: `--fresh`). Not changed: a declared section is still compared with the dimensions of the whole body; no catalog asset needs more (20 assets declare sections, only this one was flagged), it is noted under D50 for the dev.

heading: multiview MH-4 — `evaluate`: the union of a prism swept along v throws
text: Defect of `unionPolygons`, repaired at the root (`S/🔨️modules/🔺️polygon/🟦️.ts`). Reproduced with `🧰️matrix/MX/union-repro.ts` (the level edge `0.0509 → 0.0509` put back on a copy of `pregnant-person`: 2 of 150 subjects throw, `waddle-contact @0.133 s` and `uniform 2/9 @0.289 s`). Cause, measured with `union-diagnose.ts`: the sweep edges of the faces stand 0.5 to 23 nanometres off the vertical of the front view (dx 5e-10 to 2.3e-8 m on dy 0.02 to 0.07 m); the slab union works with vertical slabs and cannot carry slopes of 10⁸ (area 3.339e-2 against the exact 3.3417e-2 at 0.133 s, no closed ring at 0.289 s); turned by any angle the same polygons close with the exact area. Repair: when the slab union does not close, it is repeated on the polygons turned by 0.3, 0.7, 1.1 and 1.9 rad and the rings are turned back (`SLAB_TURNS`, `turnedSlabUnion`); nothing changes where the union closed before. Test first: the two polygon sets are vectors of `🧫️fixtures/🔺️polygon-union` (`cases`, against shapely and polygon-clipping); suite `🔺️polygon-union` 23 of 27 before the repair (the new vectors red), 27 of 27 after. The workaround `unlevel` of `🧰️matrix/MH-4/fit.ts` is no longer needed; assets that carry it stay valid.

heading: multiview MH-6 — `evaluate`: the union of a prism swept along w throws
text: The same defect and the same repair as "multiview MH-4 — `evaluate`: the union of a prism swept along v" (`S/🔨️modules/🔺️polygon/🟦️.ts`, `SLAB_TURNS`). Reproduced with `🧰️matrix/MX/union-repro.ts` (the elevation hand copied into the plan of a copy of `tour-guide`: 1 of 117 subjects throws, `holding-flag @7.992 s`): 14 faces and the two 53-point end outlines seen along the profile, slivers 2.2 micrometres wide; the slab union closes on the joined polygons turned by 0.7 rad with the exact area 9.5325e-3 m². The polygon set is a vector of `🧫️fixtures/🔺️polygon-union` (`slivers`, one ring, against polygon-clipping); suite 27 of 27. The plan hand of `tour-guide` can now be the elevation hand as far as `evaluate` goes; whether it passes the silhouette guard is the other note of MH-6. This also covers "silhouette SH-1 — `evaluate`: the union of an extruded outline with many short edges" as far as its outline was of this kind; that vector was not re-measured here.

heading: multiview MB-2 — `saguaro-cactus`: the matrix of one asset does not end in 25 minutes
text: Not a defect of the checks; the generator is MM's (`U/multiview-memory.md`): no hang, one evaluation of the 1:50 representation (413 shapes, 370 extruded ribs) takes 2.2 s against 0.38 s for `jogger` and the matrix makes several thousand; MM runs the asset to its end and reports the time there. Run it with `timeout` well above 25 minutes and `--memory=2500` (a plant).

heading: multiview MB-2 — four catalog documents were rewritten with older content
text: No shared code of the multiview suite writes catalog documents (`🔎️scan.ts`, `📊️matrix.ts`, `🖨️proofs.ts` and the check CLI only read). The cause lies with a writer that held an earlier read (a tool that writes a whole document it read minutes before, or the replica resolving two writers last-writer-wins). The fixers' `writeDoc` of `🧰️matrix/MR/lib.ts` refuses to write when the file changed since it was read; a tool without that guard is the candidate. For the coordinator; nothing changed here.
